title: FLA import: symbol instance AccProps (accessibility name/description, tabIndex, tabEnabled) not decoded
description: flash8-import.ts does not decode AccProp fields from symbol instances: accessibilityName, accessibilityDescription, tabIndex, tabEnabled. These are stored in the binary CPicFrame/CPicSymbolInstance. The SWF encoder could emit AccessibilityInfo via DoAction if needed. Low priority — accessibility props rarely affect visual rendering. Fix: decode from binary, add to SymbolInstance model, optionally forward to SWF output via AS2 _accProps assignment.
